# Brookswood Automotive LTD

## About
Brookswood Automotive LTD is a auto repair based in Fareham.

## Contact
- Website: https://brookswoodautomotive.co.uk
- Phone: 01329 640779
- Email: info@brookswoodautomotive.co.uk
- Address: 4-6 Hackett Way, Fareham, PO14 1AJ

## Areas served
Brookswood Automotive LTD serves the following towns and cities:
Fareham.

## Services
- Air Conditioning Regas
- Brakes
- Car Servicing
- Clutches
- Diagnostics
- Exhausts
- MOT Testing
- Suspension Steering
- Tyres
